newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Triarc Q2 shr loss $1.14 with charges.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Triarc Q2 shr loss $1.14 with charges.

text.p: changed its fiscal year to a year consisting of 52 or 53 weeks ending on the Sunday closest to December 31 from a calendar year. The first quarter of 1997 ended on March 30, 1997, and the second quarter ended on June 29, 1997.
(b) Represents the 57 percent minority interest in the net income of the company's propane operations for the three months ended June 30, 1997; such interest was sold principally in July 1996.

(c) Represents prepayment penalties and the write-off of deferred debt costs and debt discount associated with the early extinguishment of debt during 1996 and the write off of deferred debt costs and other deferred costs during 1997.

The company said comparability between periods is not meaningful as results for the 1997 second fiscal quarter reflect company-owned Arby's restaurant operations only through May 5, 1997, the date of the sale of all of such company-owned stores, and Snapple Beverage Corp's operations only from May 22, 1997, the date of its acquisition. Following the sale of all of its company-owned stores, Arby's continued as the franchisor of the more than 3,000 store Arby's system.

Triarc recorded $37.9 million of non-recurring, primarily non-cash, charges during its 1997 second fiscal quarter ($39.8 million for the six month period) related to its acquisition of Snapple, the consolidation of Royal Crown's Florida-based offices into the New York offices of the Triarc Beverage Group and the reduction of Arby's management infrastructure upon the sale of all of Arby's company-owned restaurants.

Excluding the non-recurring charges and extraordinary charges of $3.0 million, net of tax, for the write-off of deferred financing costs upon early retirement of debt, the net loss for the second quarter of 1997 was $8.0 million, or $0.27 per share.
Full company name is Triarc Cos Inc.
